# `knowledge` — `/api/knowledge`

Knowledge router — learn text, files, URLs and PDFs (through a local Sycamore parse job) into the Qdrant knowledge base, and search it with hybrid vector + lexical ranking.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/knowledge/jobs/{job_id}`](#get-api-knowledge-jobs-job-id) | Poll a Sycamore parsing job. |
| POST | [`/api/knowledge/learn`](#post-api-knowledge-learn) | Ingest a URL, plain text, or file into the Qdrant knowledge base. |
| POST | [`/api/knowledge/preview`](#post-api-knowledge-preview) | Show how text WOULD be chunked before committing to an ingest (roadmap 1.9). |
| GET | [`/api/knowledge/search`](#get-api-knowledge-search) | Hybrid search. |
| GET | [`/api/knowledge/sources`](#get-api-knowledge-sources) | Return all indexed knowledge sources. |
| DELETE | [`/api/knowledge/sources/{source_id}`](#delete-api-knowledge-sources-source-id) | Delete a knowledge source and its embedded chunks. |
| GET | [`/api/knowledge/status`](#get-api-knowledge-status) | Report Qdrant reachability and embedding model availability. |
| POST | [`/api/knowledge/sycamore/jobs`](#post-api-knowledge-sycamore-jobs) | Parse a PDF locally via Sycamore's DETR layout model (+ optional OCR / table-structure extraction, no Aryn Cloud account needed) and return Markdown text, ready to hand to POST /learn as source_type=file. |
| POST | [`/api/knowledge/upload`](#post-api-knowledge-upload) | Extract full text from a file for Learn. |

<a id="get-api-knowledge-jobs-job-id"></a>
### `GET /api/knowledge/jobs/{job_id}`

Poll a Sycamore parsing job. Shares the same job registry as /api/tools/jobs/{id} (backend/services/gpu_jobs.py); this copy just keeps the knowledge-domain frontend from reaching into /api/tools for something unrelated.

- Handler: [`get_knowledge_job`](../../../backend/routers/knowledge.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | path | string | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `id`, the fields of `job`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Job not found | `get_knowledge_job` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="post-api-knowledge-learn"></a>
### `POST /api/knowledge/learn`

Ingest a URL, plain text, or file into the Qdrant knowledge base.

If `chunks` is given (element-aware PDF chunks from POST /sycamore/jobs), it takes priority over `text` — chunking already happened upstream, so this skips straight to embed+store instead of re-cutting by character count.

- Handler: [`learn`](../../../backend/routers/knowledge.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `application/json`, `LearnRequest`)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | integer or null | no |  |  |
| `source_type` | string | yes |  |  |
| `source` | string | yes |  |  |
| `text` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `chunks` | list of [`ChunkIn`](#schema-chunkin) or null | no |  |  |
| `title` | string or null | no |  |  |
| `added_by` | string | no | `"dashboard"` |  |
| `ollama_url` | string | no | `"http://localhost:11434"` |  |
| `qdrant_url` | string | no | `"http://localhost:6333"` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `id`, `title`, `chunks`, `version`, plus `superseded_source_id`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `text` or `chunks` is required for source_type 'text'/'file' | `learn` |
| 400 | source_type must be 'url', 'file', or 'text' | `learn` |
| 400 | the underlying error's message | `learn` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
| 502 | Could not fetch URL: {e} | `learn` |
| 503 | the underlying error's message | `learn` |

<a id="post-api-knowledge-sycamore-jobs"></a>
### `POST /api/knowledge/sycamore/jobs`

Parse a PDF locally via Sycamore's DETR layout model (+ optional OCR / table-structure extraction, no Aryn Cloud account needed) and return Markdown text, ready to hand to POST /learn as source_type=file.

Runs as a background job, not a plain request/response: OCR on a long scanned PDF can run well past a typical HTTP client timeout, and it needs to serialize behind the same GPU lock as Stable Diffusion/video jobs (backend/services/gpu_jobs.py) to avoid a concurrent-VRAM OOM on this box's single GPU. Poll GET /jobs/{id}.

ocr defaults False: verified against a real digital-text PDF that forcing OCR on introduces real misreads (periods -> colons, dropped hyphens/quotes, digit/letter swaps) on documents that already have a clean embedded text layer. Only turn it on for genuinely scanned/image-only PDFs.

- Handler: [`sycamore_partition_start_job`](../../../backend/routers/knowledge.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `multipart/form-data`, form)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | yes |  |  |
| `ocr` | boolean | no | `false` |  |
| `tables` | boolean | no | `true` |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `job_id`, `status`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | Sycamore parsing is for PDFs — use the plain /upload for other file types. | `sycamore_partition_start_job` |
| 404 | Sycamore local-inference venv not found — expected {_SYCAMORE_VENV_PYTHON}. See docs/internal/sycamore-integration-plan.md. | `sycamore_partition_start_job` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="post-api-knowledge-upload"></a>
### `POST /api/knowledge/upload`

Extract full text from a file for Learn.

Dedicated to knowledge-base ingestion: unlike /api/chat/upload (built for injecting a snippet into the current chat's context window), this does not truncate the extracted text and allows much larger files.

- Handler: [`upload_file`](../../../backend/routers/knowledge.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Request body** (required, `multipart/form-data`, form)

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | file | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `filename`, `text`, `chars`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 413 | File too large (max {limit_mb} MB) | `upload_file` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
